Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Hema - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vikram - 39 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
4. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Kunal: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Kunal walks across the courtyard.]

Kunal (excited): "That's great!"

[Kunal thinks for a moment.]

Vikram: "Really?"

[Snow begins to fall.]

Hema: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "Let's begin."

[Kunal reads a storybook.]

Vikram: "Yes, all right."

[Kunal writes in his notebook.]

Kunal (excited): "Let's see."

[Kunal studies for his exam.]

Hema: "Exactly right."

[Kunal does his homework at the table.]

Vikram: "This is amazing!"

[Kunal talks to his father on the phone.]

Kunal (laughing): "Oh wow!"

[Kunal watches cartoons on TV.]

Kunal: "Show me too!"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Kunal stands in the kitchen. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal makes tea for everyone.]

Vikram: "Oh wow!"

[Kunal chops onions for the curry.]

Hema: "Vikram, look at this."

[Kunal washes the dishes after dinner.]

Hema: "That's easy."

Scene 4: The bedroom - Day

[Kunal stands in the bedroom. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Hema: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal yawns loudly.]

Hema: "Kunal, listen!"

[Kunal stretches his arms above his head.]

Kunal: "That was such a fun day!"
